description: Build an unsigned KLV or KDA token transfer transaction on the Klever blockchain. Returns the unsigned transaction data and hash for client-side signing. The MCP server NEVER handles private keys — signing must be done externally.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit. For KLV: 1 KLV = 1,000,000 units (6 decimals). Example: to send 10 KLV, use 10000000.

assetId.description: Optional KDA token ID for non-KLV transfers (e.g. "USDT-A1B2"). Omit for KLV.

network.description: Network to use. Options: "mainnet", "testnet", "devnet", "local". Defaults to server default (mainnet).

name: send_transfer
